LOGIC ADVENTURE 22 · CLASS 30

Hedgehog’s Odd Shape Garden

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Odd one out

Four shapes match, one does not — tap the odd flower, pot and butterfly in Hedgehog’s garden.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · ODD ONE OUT

Hedgehog’s Odd Shape Garden

In every row one shape does not belong. Tap the odd one out!

Four flowers have round petals… one does not. Tap it!

Four pots are square… one is not. Tap it!

Four butterflies have circle spots… one does not. Tap it!

Garden inspected!

A pointed flower, a round pot, and a mixed-up butterfly.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This garden moves beyond color: the odd ones differ by SHAPE. Ask "what is different about it?" — naming the difference is the skill.

Prefer paper? The Hedgehog’s Odd Shape Garden worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
